findings.title: Facebook location IDs have no recorded provenance and cannot be checked
findings.claim: Eighteen opaque numeric IDs replace readable slugs, and the only test checks they are 10+ digits and unique. A wrong or swapped ID would pass and silently search the wrong city.

evidence.detail:
Swapping two IDs passes both regions.test.ts assertions. The session summary says all 18 were verified live, but that is not recorded in the repo.
Verifier: Test only asserts format and uniqueness (regions.test.ts); a swapped ID would pass. Real but inherent to external IDs.

resolution.note: IDs were verified live and a repo test cannot check Facebook behaviour; a provenance comment is a nice-to-have

recommendation.reason: The IDs were verified live per the session summary and a repo test cannot check Facebook's behaviour; a provenance comment is nice to have but not needed to land the fix.
recommendation.reopenIf: A region is found searching the wrong city, or IDs are changed without a recorded source.

findings.title: Missing facebookLocationId silently falls back to the default location
findings.claim: RegionEntry keeps the field optional and buildFacebookUrl omits the location segment when absent, so a region without an ID yields /marketplace/search with no error.

evidence.detail:
facebook.ts:1083-1085 only adds the segment when region?.facebookLocationId is truthy; RegionEntry declares it optional (regions.ts:7).
Verifier: Confirmed facebook.ts:1083-1085 and regions.ts:7: absent ID silently omits the segment. Guarded for shipped data by regions.test.ts; optionality pre-existing.

resolution.note: shipped data is guarded by regions.test.ts and the optional field was already optional before this change

recommendation.reason: The shipped data is guarded by regions.test.ts and the optionality is pre-existing; making the field required is a small follow-up tidy.
recommendation.reopenIf: Regions become user-editable or loaded from a source the test does not cover.

findings.title: Already-saved Facebook pickup searches keep their old slug URLs and stay broken
findings.claim: buildFacebookUrl only runs at discovery time; saved searches store their URLs and the scraper navigates to them unchanged, so existing pickup searches with a dead slug keep returning the default location.

evidence.detail:
facebook.ts:488,517 goto the stored searchUrl; scheduler.ts:396 parses row.urls from saved_searches; neither the diff nor db.ts initSchema rewrites stored URLs.
Verifier: Confirmed goto on stored searchUrl (facebook.ts:488,517), URLs come from saved_searches.urls, and no rewrite exists in db.ts or the diff. Existence of affected rows not checked.

resolution.note: no saved search is affected today: all 18 stored location segments are wellington, which is the account default; revisit if a non-Wellington pickup search is saved before this lands

recommendation.reason: The code path is confirmed and leaving stored slug URLs means the original silent wrong-location bug persists for existing saved searches.
